pg_hoop.title: The hoop
pg_hoop.speaker: protagonist
pg_hoop.text: A hoop on a pole, no net, and a backboard that was repainted and then rained on. The line of the court runs under the pole rather than meeting it.
pg_hoop.repeat_text: The hoop, the pole, the line running underneath.

record.text: The painted court line runs under the near hoop's pole instead of meeting it.

pg_bench.title: The bench
pg_bench.speaker: protagonist
pg_bench.text: A bench with a sports bag on it, zipped, handles up. The seat is wet and the bag is not, except on top.
pg_bench.repeat_text: The bench, the bag, the wet seat.

record.text: A zipped sports bag has been left on the bench in the yard, set square, handles up.

pg_frame.title: The climbing frame
pg_frame.speaker: protagonist
pg_frame.text: A frame of four rungs and a top bar. The paint is new except on the third rung and the top bar, where hands have been.
pg_frame.repeat_text: Four rungs, a top bar, two worn places.

record.text: The climbing frame in the yard has been repainted everywhere except where hands go.

pg_court.title: The court
pg_court.speaker: protagonist
pg_court.text: Two hoops, a centre line, and a key painted at each end. The paint at the far end is a shade darker, as if that half was done a year later.
pg_court.repeat_text: Two hoops, two keys, two shades of paint.

record.text: The two halves of the yard court were painted at different times.

pg_container.title: The container
pg_container.speaker: protagonist
pg_container.text: A metal container set on two concrete pads, no windows, one door with a bar across it and no padlock on the bar. The paint is a school colour and the container is older than the yard.
pg_container.repeat_text: The container, the bar, the missing padlock.

record.text: The equipment container's door bar has no padlock on it.

pg_tyres.title: The tyres
pg_tyres.speaker: protagonist
pg_tyres.text: Three tyres stacked against the shed wall and one lying flat, all of them painted the same green as the shed door at some point, and worn back to black where hands go.
pg_tyres.repeat_text: The tyres, painted once, worn where hands go.

record.text: The tyres against the shed were painted the same green as the shed door.
